answer: Agents selling quill illustrations of a lagoon settle rendering jobs through an optimistic computation protocol. Payment waits through a challenge window; one valid fraud proof identifying an incorrect execution step cancels the result, regardless of how many accounts endorse it. The contract replays that step against the committed program and input, treating execution evidence as the signal rather than headcount. A sybil majority cannot outvote a valid proof. This requires an honest watcher and timely proof inclusion.
